changelog:
- Added automatic dual-endpoint failover: the system now tries a domestic endpoint if the international endpoint is unreachable, with no manual intervention needed.
- Connection is now checked at the TCP level with an 8s timeout before switching endpoints.
- The final chosen endpoint is output for user reference.
- No changes to inputs, outputs, or API usage; usage and core capabilities remain unchanged.
- Internal files scripts/__pycache__/agnes_gen.cpython-313.pyc and skill-card.md were removed.
summary: 使用 Agnes AI 升级版图像生成模型 agnes-image-2.1-flash 生成图片。同时支持文生图（text-to-image）与图生图（image-to-image）。当用户说「用 Agnes 生成图片」「用 Agnes 画一张」「Agnes 生成」「用这张图生成/改成……」或明确要求使用 Agnes API 进行文生图/图生图时，加载本 skill。不消耗 WorkBuddy 积分，仅消耗 Agnes API 额度（当前图像生成免费）。
